name: XGBoost
description: Optimized distributed gradient boosting library. Industry gold standard for tabular data classification and regression. Wins Kaggle competitions and powers production ML systems worldwide.
best_for: Tabular classification and regression, feature engineering, structured data
tags: xgboost supervised classification regression gradient-boosting tabular ensemble

name: LightGBM
description: Fast gradient boosting framework using tree-based learning algorithms. Especially efficient on large-scale datasets with lower memory usage and faster training speed than XGBoost.
best_for: Large-scale tabular data, high-dimensional features, memory-constrained training
tags: lightgbm microsoft gradient-boosting supervised classification regression fast

name: CatBoost
description: Gradient boosting algorithm that handles categorical features natively without preprocessing. Provides state-of-the-art performance on tabular and heterogeneous data with GPU training support.
best_for: Categorical-heavy datasets, automatic feature handling, tabular ML
tags: catboost yandex gradient-boosting categorical supervised classification regression GPU

name: Random Forest
description: Ensemble learning method using multiple decision trees during training. Highly robust baseline that handles noisy data and feature interactions well with low tuning effort and good interpretability.
best_for: Reliable classification/regression baseline, feature importance, noisy data
tags: random-forest ensemble supervised classification regression interpretable robust

name: Logistic Regression
description: Classic statistical classification algorithm for binary and multi-class problems. Highly interpretable baseline that outputs calibrated probabilities. Preferred for regulatory environments requiring explainability.
best_for: Binary/multi-class classification, interpretable AI, medical/finance ML, baseline
tags: logistic-regression supervised classification interpretable baseline linear regulatory

name: Support Vector Machine
description: Supervised learning model that finds an optimal hyperplane to separate classes in high-dimensional feature spaces. Effective for text classification image recognition and high-dimensional sparse data.
best_for: Text classification, image recognition, bioinformatics, high-dimensional data
tags: svm support-vector-machine supervised classification high-dimensional text bioinformatics

name: Decision Tree
description: Supervised tree-based model that splits data by feature thresholds. Highly interpretable and explainable — each decision path can be visualized and explained to non-technical stakeholders.
best_for: Explainable AI, rule extraction, business decision logic, educational ML
tags: decision-tree supervised classification regression interpretable explainable rules

name: Neural Network (MLP)
description: Multi-layer perceptron neural network for supervised learning tasks. Flexible non-linear model useful for complex patterns but less preferred than deep learning frameworks for large-scale tasks.
best_for: Complex non-linear patterns, tabular-to-neural transfer, medium-scale classification
pricing_notes: Free via scikit-learn; large-scale use PyTorch/TF instead
tags: mlp neural-network supervised tabular classification regression non-linear

name: Linear Regression
description: Foundational regression technique that models the linear relationship between input features and a continuous target variable. Highly interpretable with strong theoretical guarantees for many problem types.
best_for: Continuous value prediction, baseline regression, economic forecasting, interpretable ML
tags: linear-regression supervised regression interpretable baseline continuous prediction

name: Gradient Boosting
description: Ensemble technique building models sequentially where each corrects the errors of the previous. The family that spawned XGBoost LightGBM and CatBoost. sklearn version is reliable for smaller datasets.
best_for: Classification and regression on structured data, moderate dataset sizes
tags: gradient-boosting supervised ensemble classification regression sequential

name: K-Means Clustering
description: Classic unsupervised clustering algorithm that partitions observations into K clusters based on centroid proximity. Widely used for customer segmentation market basket analysis and pattern discovery.
best_for: Customer segmentation, document clustering, image quantization, anomaly grouping
tags: kmeans clustering unsupervised segmentation grouping partitioning centroid

name: DBSCAN
description: Density-based spatial clustering algorithm that discovers clusters of arbitrary shape and identifies noise/outlier points. Does not require specifying number of clusters upfront unlike K-Means.
best_for: Geospatial clustering, anomaly detection, arbitrary-shape clusters, noise handling
tags: dbscan density clustering unsupervised anomaly arbitrary-shape geospatial noise

name: HDBSCAN
description: Hierarchical density-based clustering that extends DBSCAN to allow clusters of varying densities. More robust to parameter selection than DBSCAN and produces a hierarchy of cluster solutions.
best_for: Variable-density clustering, document similarity, bioinformatics, large-scale unsupervised
tags: hdbscan hierarchical density clustering unsupervised variable-density robust

name: Hierarchical Clustering
description: Builds a tree-like hierarchy of nested clusters using bottom-up (agglomerative) or top-down (divisive) approaches. Produces a dendrogram for visual analysis of cluster relationships and distances.
best_for: Document taxonomy, gene expression analysis, customer profiling, small-medium datasets
tags: hierarchical-clustering agglomerative dendrogram unsupervised taxonomy genomics small-data

name: Gaussian Mixture Model
description: Probabilistic model that assumes data is generated from a mixture of Gaussian distributions. Provides soft cluster membership probabilities unlike K-Means and handles elliptical cluster shapes well.
best_for: Soft clustering, density estimation, generative modeling, anomaly detection
tags: gmm gaussian-mixture probabilistic clustering soft-assignment density unsupervised

name: PCA (Principal Component Analysis)
description: Unsupervised linear dimensionality reduction technique that transforms data to orthogonal components ordered by variance. Fundamental preprocessing step for visualization noise reduction and computational efficiency.
best_for: Dimensionality reduction, visualization, noise reduction, preprocessing, feature compression
tags: pca dimensionality-reduction unsupervised linear visualization preprocessing compression

name: Autoencoder
description: Neural network architecture trained to compress data into a lower-dimensional latent representation and reconstruct it. Enables anomaly detection generative modeling and feature learning from raw data.
best_for: Anomaly detection, data compression, denoising, feature learning, VAE/generative models
tags: autoencoder deep-learning dimensionality-reduction generative unsupervised anomaly

name: Label Propagation
description: Semi-supervised graph-based algorithm that propagates labels from labeled to unlabeled nodes using graph structure. Effective when only a small fraction of training data has labels available.
best_for: Semi-supervised classification when labeling is expensive (medical, legal, NLP)
enterprise_clients: Medical imaging labs,NLP annotation reduction teams
tags: label-propagation semi-supervised graph few-labels classification annotation

name: Self-Training Classifier
description: Semi-supervised method where a classifier iteratively labels high-confidence unlabeled examples and retrains on the expanded labeled set. Wraps any scikit-learn classifier as a semi-supervised learner.
best_for: Low-label classification, text classification with limited annotation, NLP semi-supervised
tags: self-training semi-supervised pseudo-label iterative low-label text-classification

name: Pseudo-Labeling
description: Semi-supervised technique where a model trained on labeled data generates labels (pseudo-labels) for unlabeled data and retrains with the combined dataset. Core method in modern SSL and knowledge distillation.
best_for: Image classification with limited labels, modern SSL techniques, knowledge distillation
tags: pseudo-labeling semi-supervised ssl deep-learning limited-labels knowledge-distillation

name: Isolation Forest
description: Unsupervised anomaly detection algorithm that isolates observations by randomly selecting features and splitting values. Particularly effective for high-dimensional data and outperforms One-Class SVM at scale.
best_for: Fraud detection, network intrusion detection, manufacturing defect detection
tags: isolation-forest anomaly-detection unsupervised fraud outlier high-dimensional

name: One-Class SVM
description: Novelty detection algorithm that learns a decision boundary around normal data to identify outliers. Effective in low-contamination scenarios where only normal data is available during training.
best_for: Novelty detection, network traffic anomalies, medical outliers, small normal datasets
tags: one-class-svm anomaly novelty detection unsupervised boundary normal-data

name: Naive Bayes
description: Probabilistic classifier based on applying Bayes theorem with naive independence assumption between features. Extremely fast and simple — still the go-to baseline for text classification and spam filtering.
best_for: Text classification, spam filtering, NLP, real-time classification, medical diagnosis
tags: naive-bayes probabilistic supervised text-classification spam-filtering nlp fast

name: K-Nearest Neighbors
description: Non-parametric instance-based learning algorithm that classifies data by finding the K most similar training examples. Simple highly intuitive and effective for recommendation systems and similarity search.
best_for: Similarity-based classification, recommendation fallback, low-dimensional data
tags: knn nearest-neighbors supervised instance-based similarity recommendation classification

name: LASSO & Ridge Regression
description: Regularized linear regression techniques. LASSO (L1) performs feature selection by zeroing coefficients. Ridge (L2) controls coefficient magnitude. Elastic Net combines both — standard tools for high-dimensional regression.
best_for: Regularized regression, feature selection, high-dimensional data, multicollinearity
tags: lasso ridge regularization supervised regression feature-selection high-dimensional

name: t-SNE
description: Non-linear dimensionality reduction technique ideal for visualizing high-dimensional data in 2D or 3D. Widely used for exploring latent spaces of embeddings and neural network representations.
best_for: Embedding visualization, cluster exploration, high-dimensional data exploration
pricing_notes: Free via scikit-learn; GPU version via cuML
tags: tsne dimensionality-reduction visualization embedding unsupervised non-linear manifold

name: UMAP
description: Uniform Manifold Approximation and Projection — faster and more scalable alternative to t-SNE. Preserves both local and global structure. Widely used for LLM embedding visualization and single-cell genomics.
best_for: LLM embedding visualization, single-cell genomics, dimensionality reduction at scale
tags: umap dimensionality-reduction visualization embedding genomics llm fast manifold

name: Q-Learning & Reinforcement Learning
description: Model-free reinforcement learning algorithms (Q-Learning DQN PPO SAC) where agents learn optimal policies through environment interaction and reward feedback. Powers game AI robotics and RLHF fine-tuning.
best_for: Game AI, robotic control, RLHF for LLM fine-tuning, sequential decision making
pricing_notes: Free via Stable Baselines3; paid cloud simulators available
tags: reinforcement-learning q-learning rlhf ppo dqn sequential-decision robotics game-ai

name: Transfer Learning (Fine-tuning)
description: Technique where a model pre-trained on a large dataset is adapted to a specific task with minimal labeled data. Core methodology for fine-tuning LLMs image models and foundation models on domain-specific datasets.
best_for: Fine-tuning LLMs, domain adaptation, few-shot NLP, medical imaging, low-label scenarios
pricing_notes: Free via HuggingFace; GPU compute is the primary cost
tags: transfer-learning fine-tuning llm domain-adaptation foundation-model few-shot semi-supervised
